frames.name: lift
frames.pose: Two-handed axe lifted diagonally overhead; stable wide boots.

frames.name: loaded
frames.pose: Two-handed loaded overhead hold; elbows bent and knees slightly bent.

frames.name: downswing
frames.pose: Both arms committed down and forward halfway through the swing.

frames.name: contact
frames.pose: Low blade extension toward facing target; wide braced stance with bent knees.

frames.name: recoil
frames.pose: Axe low; both hands retract the handle toward the body.

registration.layout: Three columns by two rows; row-specific nonuniform source cells follow fully transparent corridors. Row separator y=539; top column separators x=534,1015; bottom column separators x=558,1049.
registration.method: Read-only Pillow RGBA scan. Each visible-alpha (>16) bounding box receives 8 source pixels of padding within its source_cell. Foot, crown, two-hand grip and silver cutting-edge anchors are manual anatomical observations in absolute source coordinates. One standing body_height per bank, never per-frame fitting.
registration.coordinate_system: Absolute source pixels. Foot is the projected midpoint of both boot sole contact centers, not source-cell center. Muzzle is legacy field naming for the middle of the outer silver axe cutting edge, not a gun muzzle.
limitations: Six key poses per view; interpolation and animation timing require native runtime review.
Manual crown, boot contact, grip and cutting-edge anchors are estimated within approximately 5 source pixels; native runtime contact placement is unverified.
Crouch, wide stance and perspective lower the projected crown in attack poses. The bank uses the single standing-ready height and does not fit or scale individual frames.
Generator retained low-alpha fringe noise (alpha 1 through 16) outside meaningful silhouettes. Raw alpha and RGB pixels are preserved unchanged.
registration.source_facing: Southeast: right and down, front face and chest visible.

validation.source_art: Visual review shows six separate complete full-body cel-painted poses, dark spiky hair, orange-red scarf, charcoal/gold armor and one silver-edged orange-black battle axe held with both hands. No gun, helmet, background, labels, ground, motion ghosts or slash effects.
validation.scope: Asset registration and alpha QA only. No source code, imports or native gameplay execution was performed by this asset worker.

provenance.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent game sprite atlas for CH01 Luo Zhen BASIC ATTACK FRONT view.
Reference image 1 (CH01_storybook_portrait_v1.png) is the authoritative character identity, face, hair, scarf, armor and rendering reference. Reference image 2 (design-reference-option3.png) is the game art style and elevated camera reference only. Generate a new atlas, not a screenshot or UI.
Canvas: requested 1536 x 1024 pixels, landscape, exactly THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows, six full-body separated characters in six invisible 512 x 512 cells. Genuine transparent alpha background and transparent gutters. No visible cell boundaries. Row-major order: lift, loaded, downswing / contact, recoil, ready. Do not print these names.
Subject in ALL six cells: the exact SAME adult male hero as reference 1, handsome clean-shaven face, dark brown windswept spiky layered hair, bright orange-red scarf, charcoal-black plate armor with copper/gold trim, orange accents, dark armored trousers and boots. A single large battle axe with a vivid ORANGE-and-BLACK head, broad curved bright SILVER cutting edge, dark leather wrapped long handle, gold/copper connector. Not a gun, not a hammer, no helmet. Exactly one axe per cell. Hold the axe with BOTH HANDS in every frame; both hands connected to the same handle.
Style: refined cel-painted illustration, warm bright fantasy adventure, crisp detailed colored outlines, simplified readable sprite shading, matching the portrait and game concept. Never photographic, never realistic rendering. Keep identical body anatomy, proportions, costume details, scarf and one fixed body scale in all six frames; only pose changes.
Camera/orientation: full-body top-down three-quarter isometric game camera elevated about 35 degrees, see crown and top shoulder surfaces. FRONT bank: hero consistently faces SOUTHEAST, toward screen RIGHT and DOWN, showing face, chest and right-facing target direction. Perspective and light stay fixed.
Six poses, EXACT row-major:
1 TOP LEFT lift: two-handed axe raised diagonally overhead, preparing downward swing, standing wide stable boots.
2 TOP CENTER loaded: two-handed axe held fully loaded diagonally overhead, elbows bent, knees slightly bent, firm wind-up.
3 TOP RIGHT downswing: both arms committed downward and forward, axe at halfway through downward swing toward the lower-right target; torso leaning slightly forward.
4 BOTTOM LEFT contact: complete axe blade extends low toward lower-right target, arms out, wide braced stance, knees bent. This is the impact key pose without any visual impact effects.
5 BOTTOM CENTER recoil: axe low in front to lower-right, both hands retract the handle back toward body, recovering from contact.
6 BOTTOM RIGHT ready: upright standing neutral two-handed low-ready axe position toward lower-right.
Layout/registration: all six complete silhouettes AND full axe blades must be uncut, with abundant clear separation. Leave at least 40 pixels true transparent margin from EVERY cell edge around every visible body part and weapon. Keep the standing head crown near 30 percent of each cell height and projected boot contact midpoint near 82 percent of each cell height. Raised hands/axe may extend above head, but never touch cell edges. Crouching can lower the head while body scale remains fixed. Center the body in each cell with room for a long axe pointing right. The two rows must not overlap.
No background, no floor, no cast shadow, no ground ellipse, no particles, no slash effects, no glow, no motion streaks, no ghosted weapons, no duplicate weapon, no text, no labels, no numbers, no watermark, no grid, no extra character. Transparent outside each clean painted silhouette.
